entries.title: Awareness
entries.practice: Notice thoughts and sensations for five minutes without judging them.
entries.reflection: What did I notice before reacting?

entries.title: Compassion
entries.practice: Choose one small helpful action without expecting recognition.
entries.reflection: Did my action respect the other person's wishes?

entries.title: Discernment
entries.practice: Write one observation, one interpretation and one alternative explanation.
entries.reflection: What evidence would change my mind?

entries.title: Service
entries.practice: Choose a manageable responsibility and complete it.
entries.reflection: Who benefited and what can I improve?

entries.title: Passion
entries.practice: Name a desire and identify a constructive action aligned with it.
entries.reflection: Is this desire mine or borrowed from others?

entries.title: Strength
entries.practice: Choose a realistic challenge and practice for ten minutes.

entries.title: Shadow
entries.practice: Privately examine an uncomfortable emotion without acting on it.
entries.reflection: What need or fear might this emotion reveal?

entries.title: Sovereignty
entries.practice: Identify a boundary and rehearse expressing it respectfully.
entries.reflection: How can I protect autonomy without violating another's?

entries.title: Accountability
entries.practice: Review one decision and identify a repair if needed.

entries.title: Rest
entries.practice: Set aside five minutes for quiet rest without performance goals.
